title: HCP — List Standing Rules — payload
description: The request payload of the HCP 2.0-draft-3 List standing rules operation (HCP 6.3, 5.4; `GET /v2/rules` in HCP 9.2, 9.4.14): a Management Client, acting for the Context Subject or a delegate, reads the standing rules. HCP defines no request schema and no parameters for this operation; the only member is the token. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3. Every maxLength, maxItems and maxProperties in this schema is a Trust Tasks framework bound (SPEC §7.3 item 19), not an HCP requirement; so is every minLength or minItems of 1 on a member HCP's own schema allows to be empty.

accessToken.description: The Management Client's HCP access token (HCP 9.3), carried unchanged. HCP's HTTP binding sends it as a Bearer token; this member carries it in the document. The provider validates it exactly as over HTTP and treats it as opaque.

Response.title: HCP — List Standing Rules — response payload
Response.description: The standing rules the caller may see. Carries HCP's `200` result, a `rules` array (HCP 9.4.14). Not paginated: HCP gives this operation no cursor. Failures use trust-task-error, not this shape.

rules.description: HCP `rules` (HCP 9.4.14): every standing rule the provider holds for the Context Subject, or, for a delegate, those whose `categories` are absent or all within the delegation's scope (pending HCP confirmation, question 28 in the spec). Empty when there is none. HCP sets no order.
